get_params: parse a params_config dictionary into a nested namespace using argparse and return grouped parameters
set_up_env: initialize the CUDA environment and optionally set up distributed training with NCCL backend
get_optimizer_and_scheduler: create an optimizer (SGD, Adagrad, or Adam) and a LambdaLR warmup scheduler from model and optim_params
save_checkpoint: save the model, optimizer, scheduler, and logger state dicts to a checkpoint file for later resumption
Logger_log_iter: log training and validation loss as BPC or perplexity along with adaptive span metrics to stdout
